notes.title: Bundle the InventArch account connector
notes.summary: The core now ships the InventArch account connector (MCP server inventarch, with the public Claude Code OAuth client), so signing in through /mcp is enough: ia:init then lists the kits the account offers, downloads each through its signed URL, verifies the SHA-256, installs it with kit.mjs add --from and binds it as the kit recommends. The session-start account offer is now a one-line pointer to that sign-in. Also fixes kit.mjs add --from on an archive whose absolute path has a drive letter under GNU tar.
